notes: Tail case (Court of the Lions), all units rewritten; all 2.5.0 masks verified and kept. U1 disambiguated among ~12 lions; U2 middle arch of the tower's triple window; U3 is a black metal rope stanchion with ropes hooked to it, so removal would leave ropes hanging in air -> replaced by a marble bollard that can still hold the ropes; U4 flag payload made specific.

difficulty.evidence_zh: 正对镜头的石狮、塔楼三联拱窗的中间拱洞、左下前景的黑色金属围栏立柱和塔楼右侧的上层瓦屋顶是四个不同对象。
difficulty.specific_protection_zh: 保留雕像、建筑结构和庭院设施。

spec.ref: the stone lion facing straight toward the camera just right of the fountain's center

units.ref_zh: 喷泉中心偏右、正对镜头的石狮
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将喷泉中心偏右、正对镜头的石狮的颜色改为深灰色。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域的颜色改为深灰色。
preserve: 其他石狮、喷泉水盘和地面。
units.reason: About a dozen identical lions; the masked one is the only one facing straight at the camera, just right of center.

spec.ref: the middle opening of the three-arch window in the upper tower

units.ref_zh: 上方塔楼三联拱窗的中间拱洞
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将上方塔楼三联拱窗的中间拱洞替换为一扇圆窗。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一扇圆窗。
preserve: 两侧拱洞、立柱、监控摄像头和塔楼墙面。
units.reason: Two flanking arches are equally 'upper left'; ref now names the middle opening.

spec.ref: the black metal rope stanchion in the lower-left foreground

units.ref_zh: 左下前景的黑色金属围栏立柱
units.instruction_ref_zh: 将左下前景的黑色金属围栏立柱替换为一根白色大理石矮柱。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 将选中区域替换为一根白色大理石矮柱。
preserve: 挂在立柱上的围绳、右侧另一根立柱和大理石地面。
units.reason: Not a stone post but a black metal stanchion; both barrier ropes hook onto it, so removing it would leave ropes floating. Replaced with a structurally different support instead.

spec.ref: the upper tiled roof to the right of the tower
spec.payload: one small red pennant flag on a short pole

units.ref_zh: 塔楼右侧的上层瓦屋顶
units.instruction_ref_zh: 给塔楼右侧的上层瓦屋顶加上一面插在短杆上的红色小三角旗。
units.instruction_noref_zh: 给选中区域加上一面插在短杆上的红色小三角旗。
units.reason: Generic 'small flag' made specific; ref distinguishes this upper roof from the lower roof spanning the facade.
